record.title: I run a solo dev agency and want more work

record.title: Implementation is instant now and the org around it moves at the same speed as always
record.text: We all know large organisations are slow. In my experience the manual work gets automated and the meetings stay exactly where they were. Generally speaking nothing changes.

record.title: We run a small agency and everything is still done by hand
record.text: Invoicing, scheduling and reporting are all manual and it costs us days every month. We are hiring an operations engineer to fix it.

cases.why: The finding from the first live HN run: four of the six buyer signals were vendors' launch posts, because a vendor's pitch quotes the buyer's words on purpose. This text hits owner_voice, capacity, needs_built, work_pain, work_named and cost at once and scored 0.95 buyer while vendor_pitch was a weight; the frame the site's own convention announces (Launch HN) is a veto instead - the verdict ends regardless of what the prose scored, and no thread frame offered beneath it can rescue a record whose own words are an announcement.

record.title: Launch HN: Rudus (YC P26) - AI takeoffs for concrete contractors
record.text: Hi HN, we've built Rudus, an AI copilot for concrete contractors. A small business on our waitlist told us: 'We run a building company and our team spends hours a week doing manual takeoffs on spreadsheets, copying estimates between Excel and our invoicing tool.
